elements.label: Jira Product Discovery 'All Ideas' list view (whole app screen)

pattern.description: The full browser screenshot of the Jira Product Discovery list view (browser chrome, top nav and left sidebar visible) pushes in to a tight crop on the ideas table, dropping the chrome and sidebar. The move happens in a few frames, right after the narrator names the product and before 'Here's a quick demo'.
pattern.why_premium: Cropping the browser chrome and sidebar away makes the table, the actual subject, fill the frame and become readable. Putting the snap-zoom in the pause between sentences gives the move a clear purpose and ties it to the narration.

build_hint.gsap: Single screenshot layer: gsap.fromTo(ui, {scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0}, {scale: 1.22, x: '-5%', y: '-2%', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power3.out', transformOrigin: '50% 30%'}); no stagger, just one container transform. Start it in the narration gap after 'Discovery.'.
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 400, mass: 0.6}}); scale = interpolate(s, [0, 1], [1, 1.22]); translate interpolate to (-5%, -2%) on one AbsoluteFill holding the screenshot; critically damped, no overshoot.

notes: Very fast push-in (most of the energy sits in about 3 frames), so it reads almost like a zoom cut. Camera verdict push_in, scale 1.22. No SFX candidates.
